sloka: सर्वभूतेषु सर्वत्र सर्वकालेषु नास्ति सः ।यो रामं प्रतियुद्ध्येत विष्णुतुल्यपराक्रमम् ।। ५.५१.४२।।।।
transliteration: sarvabhūteṣu sarvatra sarvakāleṣu nāsti saḥ ।yo rāmaṁ pratiyuddhyeta viṣṇutulyaparākramam ।। 5.51.42।।।।

translations.english: "He is equal to Visnu in valour. There is none who can dare face his rage, be it among gods, asuras, yakshas, rakshasas, vidyadharas, gandharvas uragas, siddhas, kings of kinnaras, birds and all beings at all places and at all times.
